Enterprise Edition.note: Product edition name; existing zh-CN UI sometimes says 企业版 in marketing copy, but keep the edition name in English.

Channels.note: Product name only; the common noun 'channel' is 频道.

Calls.note: Product name only; the common noun 'call' is 通话.

post.note: Existing zh-CN does not distinguish post from message; both are 消息 (e.g. 创建消息, 固定消息). Do not use 帖子.

thread.note: Established rendering is 话题, not 会话串 or 主题; Threads view = 话题.

reply.note: Noun and verb are both 回复.

direct message.note: Occasionally expanded to 私信消息 in descriptions; standalone 私信 is standard.

mention.note: Noun and verb are both 提及; @mention = @提及 or 提及.

pin.note: Pin to Channel = 固定至频道; pinned messages = 固定消息; unpin = 取消固定. A few legacy strings use 标记 — avoid.

bookmark.note: Noun; as a verb use 添加书签.

saved messages.note: save = 保存, unsave = 取消保存.

scheduled post.note: Majority rendering; 定时消息/定时发送 appear in a minority of strings.

emoji.note: Majority rendering in webapp zh-CN is 表情符; 表情 and 表情符号 appear in a minority of strings and in other repos.

custom emoji.note: Existing UI uses 自定义表情 (without 符), inconsistent with emoji = 表情符; keep the established form.

reaction.note: Consistently 表情回应, not bare 回应 or 反应; react (verb) = 添加表情回应.

away.note: Same word as leave (离开); context disambiguates.

sign in.note: log in and sign in are both 登录.

sign out.note: log out and sign out are both 退出登录.

mute.note: Channel mute is 静音 (e.g. 静音频道), same word as microphone mute in Calls.

favorite.note: Verb/adjective 收藏; the Favorites sidebar category is 收藏夹.

webhook.note: Kept in English with capital W throughout existing zh-CN.

bot.note: bot account = 机器人账号 (账号, not 帐号/账户).

sidebar.note: Majority is 侧栏 (24 vs 7); 侧边栏 appears in a minority of strings.

agent.note: Existing UI renders AI agents as AI 代理; standalone 代理 in agent contexts. 智能体 is a common industry alternative but not used here.

magic link.note: Existing zh-CN renders it simply as 登录链接 (e.g. 访客登录链接 for Guest Magic Link), describing passwordless sign-in as 免密方式. 免密登录链接 is clearer where ambiguity matters.

keyword.note: Majority is 关键词 (21 vs 6); 关键字 appears in a minority of strings.

user group.note: 用户组, not 用户群组; standalone group in this sense is 组.

display name.note: 显示名 also appears in a minority of strings.

collapsed reply threads.note: The user-facing setting title is 话题讨论 (also used for Threaded Discussions); the literal 折叠回复话题 is not used.

data retention.note: data retention policy = 数据保留策略.

compliance export.note: 合规性导出 appears in a minority of strings.

access control.note: Attribute-Based Access Control = 基于属性的访问控制.
